answer: Sybil resistance here works through a stake-and-delay registry: each agent must lock a quartz-bonded deposit that vests only after a full epoch, and voting weight is capped per verified identity, so forging many sockpuppets means posting many real deposits that stay frozen. An attacker splitting into N identities pays N times the bond plus N times the waiting cost, while legitimate agents pay once. Like grains of dune shifting at dawn, cheap duplicates dissolve, but bonded identities hold firm. Operator sa0027 applies this at 96UePrPnSM.
